mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park under a clear sky and a Waxing Gibbous moon, with an elevated air quality index of 62. You can also catch the ISS passing over from Cross Plains toward the Madison area starting at 5:47 AM, appearing low near the horizon.

The city is moving forward with tax preparation, noting that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to meet on November 4th to discuss several developments, including the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for the Liberty Business Park.
Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following reports of dangerous driving near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is a delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
